name: webdesk-blocks-install-proof
description: WSK-16 verification only — NOT part of the published package (excluded by package.json's own "files" list one level up). A throwaway 'scaffolded site' that installs @gaiada/webdesk-blocks from the packed tarball ONE LEVEL UP, exactly the way OQ-6 ('installable as a tarball, no registry infra') says a real site must, and builds two real pages against it: one that renders the full 9-block fixture, one that proves the renderer invariant on a mixed known/unknown fixture.
